content.title: Texas Children's Houston Open 2026: Gary Woodland's Winner's Payout & Prize Money Earnings For Every Player
content.text: Mar 29, 2026, 6:11 PM min read (AP Photo/Michael Wyke) In what was an emotional win, Gary Woodland, who recently revealed he’s dealing with PTSD after brain surgery a few years ago, won for the first time on the PGA Tour since the 2019 U.S. Open. The 41-year-old finished at 21-under, which gave him a five-shot victory. The winning score set a new tournament record. Woodland qualified for the Masters with the win. The purse for the tournament was $9.9 million. Read on to see how much money each of the 75 players who made the cut earned. How Much Does the Winner of the 2026 Texas Children’s Houston Open Make? Gary Woodland’s winner’s share for the 2026 Texas Children’s Houston Open was $1.782 million.
